result.instructions: Tools for CraftMyPDF, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which PDF templates do I have in my account?"; "How many PDFs and images have I generated this month against my quota?"; "Which placeholders does my invoice template expect me to fill in?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CraftMyPDF data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run craftmypdf_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run craftmypdf_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run craftmypdf_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. craftmypdf_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: craftmypdf_get_account_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: The CraftMyPDF account behind the API key: username, quota used (quota_counter) and quota total (quota_max), template count and limit, creation date. Check the quota before generating many documents. GET /get-account-info.

tools.name: craftmypdf_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: Recent generation transactions of the account, newest first: transaction_ref, type (PDFGEN, PDFPREVIEW, ...), execution time, credits used, time, file size and result status. Use it to see what was billed. GET /list-transactions.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: craftmypdf_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the PDF/image templates of the account: template_id, name, status, group, created and updated time. The template_id is what the generation tools need. Read only; templates cannot be edited here. GET /list-templates.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: craftmypdf_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: One template: its name and the sample JSON data it expects (the placeholders to fill when generating). The full layout body is only returned with include_body (it can be very large and is cut). GET /get-template.

version.description: Template version number (from craftmypdf_list_template_versions). Latest version when omitted.

include_body.description: Also return the template layout JSON (default false; cut at 40000 characters).

tools.name: craftmypdf_list_template_versions
tools.title: List template versions
tools.description: The saved versions of a template (version number, description, time, whether it is retained). Use a version number when generating to pin the layout. GET /list-template-versions.

tools.name: craftmypdf_query_template_usage
tools.title: Query template usage
tools.description: Usage statistics (how many generations) of up to 20 templates within an optional date range. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC date-times such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. GET /query-template-usage.

tools.name: craftmypdf_get_pdf_info
tools.title: Get PDF info
tools.description: Metadata of a PDF that CraftMyPDF downloads from a public https URL: page count, title, author, creator, producer, dates. May count against the account's rate limit. GET /get-pdf-info.

url.description: Public https URL of a PDF file.

tools.name: craftmypdf_create_pdf
tools.title: Create PDF from template
tools.description: WRITE: uses the CraftMyPDF account's own quota (credits; a successful generation is a billable transaction, typically 1 credit per document, and every call counts even with identical data). Generate ONE PDF from a template and your JSON data. Returns a hosted file URL (never file bytes) that expires after `expiration` minutes, plus the transaction reference and any anchors (page numbers for a table of contents). Look the template up with craftmypdf_list_templates / craftmypdf_get_template first. POST /create with export_type=json.

data.description: The JSON object that fills the template's {{placeholders}}, e.g. {"invoice_number":"INV38379","total_amount":82542.56}. The whole request must stay under about 3.8 MB.

version.description: Template version number (from craftmypdf_list_template_versions). Latest version when omitted.

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file is deleted from CraftMyPDF's CDN, 1-10080 (default 60; the vendor default is 5).

output_file.description: File name of the output (default output.pdf).

image_resample_res.description: Downsample images to this DPI to shrink the PDF: 72, 150, 300, 600 or 1200.

tools.name: craftmypdf_create_image
tools.title: Create image from template
tools.description: WRITE: uses the CraftMyPDF account's own quota (credits; a successful generation is a billable transaction, typically 1 credit per document, and every call counts even with identical data). Generate ONE image (JPEG or PNG) from a template and your JSON data. Returns a hosted file URL (never file bytes) that expires after `expiration` minutes. POST /create-image with export_type=json.

data.description: The JSON object that fills the template's {{placeholders}}, e.g. {"invoice_number":"INV38379","total_amount":82542.56}. The whole request must stay under about 3.8 MB.

version.description: Template version number (from craftmypdf_list_template_versions). Latest version when omitted.

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file is deleted from CraftMyPDF's CDN, 1-10080 (default 60; the vendor default is 5).

output_file.description: File name of the output (default output.jpg).

tools.name: craftmypdf_create_pdf_from_templates
tools.title: Create one PDF from several templates
tools.description: WRITE: uses the CraftMyPDF account's own quota (credits; a successful generation is a billable transaction, typically 1 credit per document, and every call counts even with identical data). Generate ONE combined PDF from 2-10 templates, each with its own data (or the shared `data`). Costs credits for each template rendered. Returns a hosted file URL that expires after `expiration` minutes. Uses the latest template versions. POST /create-merge with export_type=json.

data.description: Data for this template; falls back to the shared data.
Shared data for entries without their own.

paging.description: Page numbering across the templates: reset (default) restarts at each template, continuous carries on.

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file is deleted from CraftMyPDF's CDN, 1-10080 (default 60; the vendor default is 5).

output_file.description: File name of the output (default output.pdf).

annotations.title: Create one PDF from several templates

tools.name: craftmypdf_merge_pdfs
tools.title: Merge PDFs by URL
tools.description: WRITE: uses the CraftMyPDF account's own quota (credits; a successful generation is a billable transaction, typically 1 credit per document, and every call counts even with identical data). Merge 2-10 existing PDFs, given as public https URLs, into ONE PDF. CraftMyPDF downloads the files from your URLs. Returns a hosted file URL that expires after `expiration` minutes. POST /merge-pdfs.

urls.description: 2-10 public https URLs of PDF files, merged in this order.

expiration.description: Minutes until the hosted file is deleted from CraftMyPDF's CDN, 1-10080 (default 60; the vendor default is 5).

output_file.description: File name of the output (default output.pdf).
